breakfast.name: Jook (Thai Rice Porridge)
breakfast.description: A comforting Thai rice porridge made from jasmine rice simmered in broth until creamy, topped with savory ingredients like fried pork, soft-boiled eggs, and fresh garnishes
ingredients: Salt and white pepper to taste
instructions: Rinse jasmine rice under cold water
In large pot, bring broth and water to boil
Add rice and bring back to boil, stirring occasionally
Reduce heat to low and simmer 60-90 minutes, stirring occasionally
Rice should completely break down and porridge reach creamy consistency
Alternative: partially break dry rice grains before cooking to reduce time
Season with salt and white pepper
Pour into bowls and add desired toppings
Serve hot with various condiments on the side
breakfast.notes: Breaking dry rice grains before cooking unlocks starch and creates velvety texture. Thai jasmine rice creates signature fragrant and creamy jook
breakfast.fun_fact: Jook is the Thai version of rice porridge (congee) and is traditionally eaten for breakfast or when feeling under the weather
alternatives: Use chicken broth for richer flavor

lunch.name: Pad Thai (Thai Stir-Fried Noodles)
lunch.description: National dish of Thailand - rice noodles stir-fried with tamarind, fish sauce, and peanuts. Became national dish in 1930s-40s
instructions: Soak rice noodles in room temperature water for 30 min until pliable
Mix tamarind paste, fish sauce and sugar in bowl
Heat wok, add oil and garlic, cook 30 seconds
Add shrimp or chicken, cook until done
Push to side, scramble eggs, mix in
Add drained noodles and sauce, toss 2-3 minutes
Add bean sprouts, scallions and half the peanuts
Serve topped with remaining peanuts and lime wedge
lunch.notes: Tamarind paste is essential for authentic flavor. Balance of sweet, sour, salty is key
lunch.fun_fact: Pad Thai became national dish of Thailand in 1930s-40s as part of nation-building campaign

dinner.name: Thai Green Curry (Spiced Coconut Curry with Green Chilies)
dinner.description: Spiced coconut curry with green chilies - classic Thai dinner
ingredients: For Curry Paste: 4-5 green Thai chilies, 2 serrano chilies, 1 tbsp coriander seeds, 1 tbsp cumin seeds, 1 tsp white peppercorns, 3 stalks lemongrass, 2 tsp galangal, 2 tbsp cilantro stems, 4 garlic cloves, 3 shallots, 2 tbsp Thai basil, 3 makrut lime leaves, 1 tbsp white miso, salt
instructions: Prepare curry paste: pound all paste ingredients until thick and fragrant (30-45 minutes traditional)
Heat thick cream layer from coconut milk in pot
Add curry paste; fry 3-4 minutes until fragrant
Add chicken stock; bring to simmer
Add eggplant and lime leaves; simmer 5 minutes
Stir in remaining coconut milk
Add cubed chicken; simmer 8-10 minutes until cooked
Stir in bamboo shoots, fish sauce, palm sugar
Simmer 2 minutes
Remove from heat; stir in lime juice, fresh basil, red chilies
Serve with jasmine rice
dinner.notes: Curry paste can be made in advance and frozen
dinner.fun_fact: Gaeng Kiew Waan literally means 'sweet green curry' referring to color and basil aromatics

dinner.name: Massaman Curry (Mild Spiced Beef Curry)
dinner.description: Mild Thai curry with beef, potatoes, and peanuts - comfort curry
instructions: Heat oil in large pot over medium heat
Add massaman curry paste, cook 3 minutes until fragrant
Add beef, brown on all sides (5-7 minutes)
Add coconut milk and beef stock
Add bay leaves, cinnamon stick, cardamom pods, cloves
Bring to simmer and cook 25 minutes
Add potatoes and onions
Continue simmering 20 minutes until potatoes are tender
Add peanuts, tamarind paste, palm sugar, fish sauce
Simmer 10 more minutes to marry flavors
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and more fish sauce if needed
Remove whole spices before serving (or leave for diners to identify)
Serve over jasmine rice or with roti bread
dinner.notes: Massaman is the mildest Thai curry - good introduction to Thai cuisine
dinner.fun_fact: Massaman is influenced by Persian and Indian cuisines, showing Thailand's cultural crossroads
alternatives: Use peanut butter if whole peanuts unavailable
